description:
If there are three things to avoid in office romances, alcoholism, or dating an ex-boyfriend, I met a man who fulfills all of them. He suggested we meet casually and without pressure, but before I knew it, he thrust his raw sincerity at me.

“Let’s have a deep, heavy, and burdensome relationship.”

A man hiding a refreshing smile behind a decadent appearance, and a woman harboring similar deficiencies behind a fiery personality.

In a relationship that began like a joke, Two hollow people have become entangled.

A relationship that offers both destruction and salvation simultaneously. A connection that started lightly draws them together with unexpected depth.

It is funny, then painful, then funny again—an emotional romance as light as a tissue and as heavy as a stone.
